html: צפח (√ of foll.; cf. Arabic صَفَحَ ii. make wide, broad; صَفِيحَة anything broad (stone, plank, sheathing, plating), Syriac ܨܦܺܝܚܬܳܐ plating; also Ethiopic ሰፍሐ: spread out, extend; Sab. (Liḥ.) הצפחת, אצפחת, platform, DHMEpigr. Denkm. 84, 86; but (transp.) Arabic صَحْفَةٌ, wide bowl, cf. Frä63).
